user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Desert Oasis Camp. A desert oasis at dusk: a turquoise pool ringed by date palms and reeds, rolling dunes with wind-carved ridges, a pair of striped nomad tents, a campfire with drifting sparks, woven rugs and cushions, clay water jars, a resting camel silhouette, and the first stars appearing over the dunes as the fire flickers. Style: golden-hour stylized realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
